hook.text: Imagine testing every possible auction format to find the best one. There are infinitely many. Seems impossible.

buildup.text: The revelation principle: if any mechanism achieves a goal, there's a direct one where players just report truthfully.

discovery.text: This collapses the design problem: instead of exploring all possible games, just find the best truth-telling one.

twist.text: It doesn't mean truth-telling mechanisms are simple to build. It means you only need to search among them.

climax.text: Roger Myerson proved this theorem, transforming mechanism design from art into systematic engineering.

punchline.text: Truth-telling isn't naive—it's optimal by design.

quiz.question: What does the revelation principle simplify?
options: The search space for mechanism designers
